reply.text:
Eating that infrequently makes it genuinely hard to build muscle — your body needs a steady supply of protein and total calories to actually repair and grow, and going 48 hours between meals works against both. That's not a training tweak I can fix with your program; it's an eating pattern question, and if there's a reason behind it (medical, scheduling, something else), that's worth talking through with a doctor or dietitian who can look at the full picture.

What I can tell you on the training side: if you want muscle, more frequent eating with enough protein spread across the day is going to serve you a lot better than one meal every two days. Want me to pull up some higher-protein recipes that are quick to fit in more often?
